rules: This story's acceptanceCriteria requires updating the test file src/hello.test.ts (change the assertion from 'hello world' to 'hello dolly') even though technicalNotes.files only lists src/hello.ts. You MUST modify both files to satisfy all three acceptance criteria. The test file imports getGreeting from './hello' and asserts getGreeting().toBe('hello world') — update that to toBe('hello dolly').

This project has no vitest.config.ts file; vitest runs with default configuration. Run tests with npx vitest run (or node ./node_modules/.bin/vitest run). The tsconfig.json includes vitest/globals in types but the existing test file imports from 'vitest' explicitly — follow the existing import pattern.

This project uses CommonJS module system (no 'type':'module' in package.json). TypeScript is configured with module:'CommonJS', target:'ES2020', strict:true, noEmit:true. Do not use ESM syntax (top-level await, .mjs extensions) or add module overrides.
